parts.content: Read-only, medium thoroughness exploration in d:\HealthcareAccelerator. The user asks to complete the backend implementation for the existing Processing Queue frontend. Identify the smallest existing paths and contracts for: creation/persistence of processing records; current processing/status queries; extraction review; POC approval; any PostgreSQL schema/migrations and repositories that can feed a real queue. Also identify where FastAPI routers are composed (if anywhere) and relevant tests. Do not edit files. Return precise paths, named types/methods, and a recommendation for the minimal complete backend slice to replace app.main static queue records. Note blockers or unimplemented infrastructure clearly.
